limit: Unset CLI limit, with the product default of 12
comparison: Run both modes on the same copied and rebuilt official case home with the exact same pinned executable and question. Disable scope inference. Keep the default relevance threshold.
primary: Require more complete reference sets at five with unset ranking and a one-sided exact paired McNemar p-value below 0.05.
secondary: Require at least as many complete reference sets at ten with unset ranking as with hybrid.
coverage: Require all 450 valid pairs. Retry only cases with setup or operational failures. Preserve the protocol if a case fails.
